verdict.rationale: Semgrep Secrets clearly detects exposed API keys, passwords, and credentials in scanned code, with validity checking and PR/MR comment integration (semgrep-docs-8, semgrep-docs-9, semgrep-docs-10, semgrep-docs-32). However, evidence only shows scanning of the current codebase/files, not the full git history for previously-committed secrets; the pre-commit hook doc even frames Semgrep as *preventing* secrets from entering git history going forward, not retroactively scanning historical commits. Missing for 10: explicit capability/documentation for scanning entire git history (all past commits) for secrets, evidence of a history-scan mode or command, and independent confirmation of historical secret detection.
